subject: @abh/core and @abh/adapter-fastify bounded projection production metrics
coverage: projection_lag is reported as the age of the oldest unconsumed eligible event
gap_count is a tenant-scoped count of eligible events without a consumer Inbox
rebuild_failure increments only when a projection consumer rebuild fails
sse_drop distinguishes slow client, reset and disconnected outcomes
query_redaction_count records successful server-side fieldSet redaction
metric series have no actor, subject, organization or object labels
SSE drop labels are limited to three fixed reasons
negative, fractional and overflowing metric values are rejected
a failing metric exporter does not fail projection reads, workers or SSE
worker onPage remains bounded and reports cycle work with lag and gap
real PostgreSQL reports zero lag and zero gaps after historical repair
Fastify reset behavior records reset without emitting object information
limits: metric snapshots are an in-process host exporter boundary, not a Prometheus server
projection subscriptions for other domains remain open
